newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Former U.S. president Carter meets Brazil leader.
newsitem.headline: Former U.S. president Carter meets Brazil leader.

text.p: Former U.S. president Jimmy Carter on Wednesday met Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso during a five-day visit to Latin America's largest country.

The U.S. embassy said Carter was travelling through Latin America to make contact with government leaders ahead of a conference on the region's future. The conference, hosted by the Carter Centre, will take place in Georgia in April.
Carter was due to take part in a round table discussion on human rights later on Wednesday and was scheduled to give a news conference on Thursday.

He travels to the Amazonian capital of Manaus on Thursday afternoon for a tour of the rain forest. Carter, who has already visited Chile and Argentina, heads for Jamaica on Saturday on the last leg of his Latin American tour.
